text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e to m-i-m-i-c a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c p-r-o-d-u-c-t b-a-t-c-h e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-a-n-u-f-a-c-t-u-r-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
2) the a-c-t-o-r f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-d-e-s to c-r-e-a-t-e p-l-a-u-s-i-b-l-e u-n-i-t i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the n-u-m-be-r-r-a-n-g-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l
3) the a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n d-a-t-a to s-h-o-w c-o-n-t-i-n-u-o-u-s t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-a-w-s-e-n-s-o-r a-u-d-i-t-t-r-a-i-l r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-o-u-t-e-d the g-o-o-d-s to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y n-e-t-w-o-r-k-s b-e-f-o-r-e re-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y s-c-r-u-t-i-n-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the w-h-o-l-e-s-a-l-e r-e-c-i-p-i-e-n-t q-u-a-l-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d the f-e-l-s-e b-a-t-c-h r-e-c-o-r-d-s i-n-t-o the i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y s-y-s-t-e-m to e-v-o-l-v-e t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y c-o-v-e-r-a-g-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t c-r-o-s-s c-h-e-c-k
